Hot Shrimp Dip
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:35am

Ingredients




2 ounces pkt cream cheese (8  ea.)
1 medium tomato chopped fine
1 medium onion chopped fine
1 jalapeno peppers (to 3/to taste) chopped fine
1 cloves garlic (to 2) put through a press
2 cups cooked and peeled shrimp (at least) cut up

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients except shrimp in a double boiler or in the microwave until theyOre softened and can be blended together. Add shrimp. Chill for at least 8 hours. Heat in chafing dish and serve with chips for dipping.
